parsed.rationale: Both `ArtistRepository` and `ReleaseRepository` in the `Metadata` package share three identical members — `cacheKey:(for id: Int) -> String`, `entityKind:String`, and `lastSync:Date?` — and differ only in the return type of `resolve:(id: Int) async throws -> <Entity>`. This is the canonical PAT pattern: a single varying slot (the resolved entity type) across otherwise identical protocol shapes. Introducing `MetadataRepository` with `associatedtype Entity` and a `resolve(id: Int) async throws -> Entity` requirement unifies both protocols without loss of type safety. Neither record carries any restraint marker (`is_test`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app`, `is_codegen` are all false), so no no-action override applies.
